configuration.note: Gradual Map2 mob/boss recovery after target loss. Native Buff70 args8 has no verified binding to this transition.

nativeEvidence.CCBloodBarComp: original onAddHP consumes changeHP/currentHP/maxHP and updates bar, executed in VM
nativeEvidence.Buff70BindingToLeash: NOT_FOUND; args8 is not treated as8% or8seconds for this behavior

localPolicies.start: on first return-home/fastback or home-reset decision with no target; first step after1000ms
localPolicies.amount: floor(maxHP*10/100), at least1, capped at missingHP; both mobs and bosses
localPolicies.stop: new AI target or real incoming damage, fullHP, death, zeroHP, stale spawn life, non-Map2 or summoned actor
localPolicies.home: healing continues after arrival until full unless interrupted; arrival itself never resets HP
localPolicies.catchUp: at most one step per observed tick; empty room pauses timer and clears per-peer correction; no offline burst
localPolicies.delivery: native addHP only for current observers; failed send retains one latest setHP correction per peer bound to world and target life, no duplicate floating-heal retry
localPolicies.respawn: new life retains existing fullHP initialization and clears recovery state; natural respawn is distinct from disengage
localPolicies.configReload: restart server after editing JSON; interval minimum250ms; rate0 disables steps

scope: Map2 world mobs/bosses; no change to other map reset behavior
